Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

UNTESTED - original theorycraft, ranked by nobody in this form. Every published Rogue build this season is a bow build; the melee dagger side of the class is sitting at B tier on both Maxroll lists. But 3.1.x quietly stacked three buffs onto exactly that side: Flurry's damage went 140% to 196% (a 40% increase), the Way of the Blurring Blade talisman went 45% to 60% on its 2-piece and 200% to 250% on its 5-piece, and The Maestro went 24-30% to 45-60%. Meanwhile the bow builds' best-in-slot helm, Harlequin Crest, lost its Damage Reduction - which hurts a close-range build less than it hurts nothing, but means the defensive gap between melee and ranged narrowed from the ranged side. The thesis is that the tier lists have not caught up with a set of buffs that all landed on one archetype. I am openly sceptical of my own idea: Flurry sits in B tier on both Maxroll lists and the tier lists were updated after these buffs, which is real evidence against.

Rotation
  1. Shadow Clone to open and apply Vulnerable, Dash in, Flurry the pack, and Dark Shroud before the elite's telegraph rather than after.
  2. Poison Imbuement up, Forceful Arrow at range when Energy runs dry.
Variants

Leveling — Poison Imbuement, close with Dash, Flurry the pack, Shadow Step out if it goes wrong. Forceful Arrow to refill Energy at range.
Move on when Level 70 and Torment 1 unlocked. Do not start the experiment until you have at least the Way of the Blurring Blade 2-piece - without it you are just playing a worse bow Rogue.

Early Endgame — Poison Imbuement up, Shadow Clone for Vulnerable, Dash in, Flurry, Dark Shroud proactively. This is the stage where you should do the first real measurement: record a Pit clear time here before the 5-piece, so you have a baseline to compare against once the set completes.
Move on when Way of the Blurring Blade 5-piece assembled. That is the moment the hypothesis becomes testable - everything before this is just a mediocre melee Rogue.

Late Endgame — Full loop with the 5-piece online. Take the second measurement here against the same Pit tier you baselined at early_endgame, and against a lair boss for single target. Compare honestly - if the 5-piece did not produce a step change, the multiplicative assumption was wrong and the build should be retired rather than tuned.
Move on when Only proceed if the 5-piece measurement showed a clear step change over the early_endgame baseline. If it did not, retire this build and play rogue-meta-penetrating-shot.

Pushing — Shadow Clone to open and apply Vulnerable, Dash in, Flurry, Dark Shroud before the elite's telegraph rather than after. Be realistic about the ceiling: no source ranks any melee Rogue build above B tier this season, so if you reach a wall two or three Pit tiers below what rogue-meta-penetrating-shot manages, that is the expected outcome and not a gearing failure.

Point allocation, in order69 points across 10 nodes

Constructed by the specialist, not copied from a guide - untested, like the rest of this build. Flurry's own upgrade mods are not recorded because no source consulted on 2026-08-08 published them, and inventing mod names would be worse than leaving them out. Every other node here is a name Maxroll's Season 14 planner data confirms. Levelling is the safest part of this build - Maxroll and Icy Veins both publish real Flurry guides, so this stage is not speculative even though the endgame thesis is.

Skill point priority

  1. Flurry to max
  2. Forceful Arrow for Energy - Flurry is as Energy-hungry as any Rogue core skill
  3. Poison Imbuement for the damage conversion
  4. Dash and Shadow Step to close and escape, which matters far more for a melee Rogue
  5. Shadow Clone as the ultimate for Vulnerable and Weaken

Higher than the Poison bow build runs it. A dagger build closes distance for a living and Dash stacks Ferocity while doing it.

  4. Shadow Clone max as the Vulnerable source
  5. Dash for the gap-close and Ferocity
  6. Inner Sight specialization for Energy

Board & glyph focus

Damage boards first, then Energy regeneration, then crit. Bias defensive nodes higher than a bow build would - you are eating the hits a Penetrating Shot Rogue never takes.

How to run them

Not constructed - this is what Maxroll's live Flurry Rogue guide runs, which is a useful anchor for a build that is otherwise speculative. Hire Subo and take Seeker and Opening Fire; Opening Fire's +25% Critical Strike Damage is straightforwardly good on a build that lands a great many small hits. Reinforce with Raheir and pick Provoke. Icy Veins' Flurry guide independently reaches the same hire with a Bastion reinforcement instead - between Provoke and Bastion, take Bastion if you are dying and Provoke if you are struggling to keep a pack together. Note that this is the opposite arrangement from the Penetrating Shot builds, both of which reinforce with Varyana for attack speed; the reasoning is that a melee Rogue's problem is staying alive in the pack, not attacking faster.

Plan

Constructed, and constrained by the same gap as every Rogue build on this site: no Rogue guide publishes War Plan picks, and Maxroll's Penetrating Shot planner has all seven activity trees empty on all eleven profiles. The picks below are Maxroll's build-agnostic Season 14 priorities, reordered around what this build actually needs - which is unusual, because the entire thesis rests on assembling the Way of the Blurring Blade 5-piece. Talismans come from Infernal Hordes, so the Hordes tree gets a priority here that it gets on no other build in this season's set.

What is lit7 picks recorded on 4 of 7 activities. Everything else is dimmed, not ruled out: the trees below are the game's own 100 nodes, and a War Plan is per character.
Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

UNTESTED - original theorycraft, ranked by nobody in this form. Every published Rogue build this season is a bow build; the melee dagger side of the class is sitting at B tier on both Maxroll lists. But 3.1.x quietly stacked three buffs onto exactly that side: Flurry's damage went 140% to 196% (a 40% increase), the Way of the Blurring Blade talisman went 45% to 60% on its 2-piece and 200% to 250% on its 5-piece, and The Maestro went 24-30% to 45-60%. Meanwhile the bow builds' best-in-slot helm, Harlequin Crest, lost its Damage Reduction - which hurts a close-range build less than it hurts nothing, but means the defensive gap between melee and ranged narrowed from the ranged side. The thesis is that the tier lists have not caught up with a set of buffs that all landed on one archetype. I am openly sceptical of my own idea: Flurry sits in B tier on both Maxroll lists and the tier lists were updated after these buffs, which is real evidence against.

Rotation
  1. Shadow Clone to open and apply Vulnerable, Dash in, Flurry the pack, and Dark Shroud before the elite's telegraph rather than after.
  2. Poison Imbuement up, Forceful Arrow at range when Energy runs dry.
Variants

Leveling — Poison Imbuement, close with Dash, Flurry the pack, Shadow Step out if it goes wrong. Forceful Arrow to refill Energy at range.
Move on when Level 70 and Torment 1 unlocked. Do not start the experiment until you have at least the Way of the Blurring Blade 2-piece - without it you are just playing a worse bow Rogue.

Early Endgame — Poison Imbuement up, Shadow Clone for Vulnerable, Dash in, Flurry, Dark Shroud proactively. This is the stage where you should do the first real measurement: record a Pit clear time here before the 5-piece, so you have a baseline to compare against once the set completes.
Move on when Way of the Blurring Blade 5-piece assembled. That is the moment the hypothesis becomes testable - everything before this is just a mediocre melee Rogue.

Late Endgame — Full loop with the 5-piece online. Take the second measurement here against the same Pit tier you baselined at early_endgame, and against a lair boss for single target. Compare honestly - if the 5-piece did not produce a step change, the multiplicative assumption was wrong and the build should be retired rather than tuned.
Move on when Only proceed if the 5-piece measurement showed a clear step change over the early_endgame baseline. If it did not, retire this build and play rogue-meta-penetrating-shot.

Pushing — Shadow Clone to open and apply Vulnerable, Dash in, Flurry, Dark Shroud before the elite's telegraph rather than after. Be realistic about the ceiling: no source ranks any melee Rogue build above B tier this season, so if you reach a wall two or three Pit tiers below what rogue-meta-penetrating-shot manages, that is the expected outcome and not a gearing failure.

Reasoning

HypothesisFlurry's 3.1.x base damage increase from 140% to 196% and the Way of the Blurring Blade talisman's simultaneous 2-piece (45% to 60%) and 5-piece (200% to 250%) buffs are multiplicative with each other, so the combined effect on a full 5-piece Blurring Blade Flurry build is substantially larger than any single line item suggests - large enough that a melee dagger Rogue should be competitive with the B-tier bow builds and possibly with the A-tier ones, despite no tier list having moved it.
Confidencelow
How to test itFirst check the arithmetic in-game before investing: confirm whether the Way of the Blurring Blade 2-piece and 5-piece bonuses actually multiply with each other and with Flurry's base damage, or whether they are additive with other damage buckets. If they are additive, this build is dead on arrival and you should stop. Second, this build has no answer yet to the thing that makes the bow builds work - Eaglehorn's wall bounce has no melee equivalent - so measure single-target damage against a lair boss, not clear speed on trash, because clear speed is where melee will look artificially fine. Third, the honest counter-evidence: Maxroll rates Flurry B tier on BOTH its overall endgame list (updated 2026-07-22) and its push list (updated 2026-07-23), and both dates are after the 3.1.0 buffs landed. If experienced theorycrafters already looked at these numbers and left Flurry in B, the most likely explanation is that they are right and I am wrong. Treat a successful test as surprising. Fourth, survivability: you are in melee range without Harlequin Crest's old Damage Reduction, which was removed in 3.1.x - if you are dying more than once per Pit run at your farming tier, the build is not viable regardless of its damage.

Physical Damage

Dark Shroud

Subterfuge

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Surround yourself with up to 5 protective shadows. Gain +8.0% Resistance to All Elements per active shadow. If you have the maximum amount of shadows, direct damage is reduced by 20.0%. Each time you take direct damage, a shadow is consumed.

Modifiers

  • OverflowDark Shroud no longer grants Resistance to All Elements, but instead grants you 15% increased Energy Regeneration per shadow.
  • Consume ChanceDark Shroud shadows have a 15% chance to not be consumed.
  • Critical StrikeWhile you have at least 1 active shadow from Dark Shroud, gain 5%[+] Critical Strike Chance.

Poison Imbuement

Imbuements

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Lucky Hit Chance: 33%

Imbue your weapons with lethal poison for 6 seconds. While imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Poison damage and apply 100% of their Base damage as additional Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.

Modifiers

  • PToxic TouchPoison Imbuement gains 40%[x] increased Potency. Each successive time an enemy is Poisoned by Poison Imbuement, the Potency of Poison Imbuement against the enemy is increased by 5%[x], up to 50%[x].
  • DurationPoison Imbuement's duration is increased by 2 seconds. Casting Poison Imbuement consumes up to 2 stacks of Ferocity to further increase its duration by 2 per Ferocity spent.
  • CooldownLucky Hit: Poison Imbued Skills have up to a 30% chance to reduce the Cooldown of Poison Imbuement by 2 seconds.
Poison Damage

Shadow Clone

UltimateCutthroat

Rank 15/15

Cooldown: 60 seconds

Summon a shadow that mimics your actions for 15 seconds. This Shadow Clone deals 40% of your damage.

Modifiers

  • AwakeningPassive: After spending 100 Energy, your next Core Skill Cast becomes a Shade Skill and spawns a Shade that deals 40% of its damage. Shadow Clone is now also a Shade Skill and its duration is reduced by 50%[x].
  • Weaken & VulnerableCasting Shadow Clone makes all Nearby enemies Weakened and Vulnerable for 6 seconds.
  • ResolveCasting Shadow Clone grants 4 stacks of Resolve. While any Shadow Clone is active, you gain 1 Resolve per 1 second.

Thrillseeker

PassiveSubo

Your active Cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds when an Explosive Charge explodes.

Explosive Charges now detonate after only 1.5 seconds.

Bargaining Chips

PassiveSubo

Targets stuck with Explosive Charges take 5%[x] increased damage per Explosive Charge stuck.

Incendiary Bolt

PassiveSubo

If Subo's Snipe hits the target he originally aimed at, a Molotov explodes on them.

Ambusher

PassiveSubo

You gain 20%[x] Lucky Hit Chance against enemies damaged by Subo's Salvo within the last 3 seconds.

Share a Drink

PassiveSubo

When one of Subo's Molotovs explodes, it has a 50% chance to drop a Healing Potion for you.

Scorched Earth

PassiveSubo

Subo's initial Molotov explosions cause enemies to take 30%[x] increased Damage Over Time from you for 3 seconds.

Mastermind

PassiveSubo

Subo's Wire Trap and Trip Mines explosions gain 60% Size.

You and Subo gain 25%[+] Crowd Control Duration.

Loaded Munitions

PassiveSubo

Subo's Wire Traps and Trip Mines inflict Vulnerable on enemies for 5 seconds.

Opening Fire

PassiveSubo

You deal 25%[x] increased Critical Strike Damage to enemies hit by Subo's Cover Fire for 4 seconds.

Pin Cushion

PassiveSubo

Subo's Cover Fire also Immobilizes enemies for 3 seconds.

Ready At Hand

PassiveSubo

Direct damage to an Elite grants you 20%[+] Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

Piercing Arrows

PassiveSubo

Subo's Heavy Shot now pierces through enemies.

Trip Mines

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 18 seconds

Subo scatters 3 explosive traps that each arm after 1.0 seconds. When an enemy moves within range of one, it explodes for 300% Physical damage and Knocks Down enemies for 1.5 seconds.

Cover Fire

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Subo charges a countless volley of arrows, then unleashes it over your position for 140% Physical damage that Slows enemies by 50% for 4 seconds.

Explosive Charge

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 22 seconds

Subo fires 4 Explosive Charges that stick to enemies. Each explodes after 6.5 seconds or when their target dies, dealing 60% Physical damage.

Snipe

Iconic skillSubo

Cooldown: 20 seconds

Subo charges a massive piercing bolt, then unleashes it forwards for 450% Physical damage that Knocks Back enemies.

Wire Trap

Core skillSubo

Cooldown: 10 seconds

Weapon: Bow

Basic Attack: Heavy Shot

Subo places a concussive trap that arms after 0.8 seconds. When an enemy moves within range, it explodes for 80% Physical damage and Stuns enemies for 2.0 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Subo fires a toughened arrow at an enemy, dealing 80% Physical damage with a 30% chance to Stun for 1.0 seconds.

Molotov

Core skillSubo

Cooldown: 11 seconds

Weapon: Crossbow

Basic Attack: Salvo

Subo tosses an incendiary at an enemy, dealing 10% Physical damage and Stunning them for 1.0 seconds before exploding into flames. For the next 5 seconds, enemies within the area repeatedly take 36% Burning damage over 3 seconds.

Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

Subo launches 5 bolts at an enemy, each dealing 30% Physical damage. The final bolt explodes, Slowing enemies by 50% for 2 seconds.

Tree of Plenty

Tree of Whispers

The Tree offers a fourth Whisper Cache choice.

Headrotten Feast

Tree of Whispers

Headrotten Bosses that are drawn to Exposed Roots have +1 Monster Power, and will always drop a Whisper Cache.

Resplendent Favor

Tree of Whispers

Each Whisper Cache has a chance to drop a Resplendent Spark.

Malignant Invasion

Tree of Whispers

Varshan can now appear in a Whisper Ambushes.

Slay Varshan to earn the contents of an Ancestral Collection of Chaos .

Grim Retribution

Tree of Whispers

Completing a Whisper has a chance to trigger a Whisper Ambush.

These enemies have a chance to burst out the contents of a Collection of Chaos when slain.

Roots of Power

Tree of Whispers

Enemies that are drawn to Exposed Roots have +1 Monster Power.

Planting Corrupted Roots in Helltides yields double rewards.

Colossal Foe

Tree of Whispers

Whisper Ambushes sometimes include Bosses.

These Bosses will always burst out the contents of a Greater Collection of Chaos when slain.

Simple Gifts

Tree of Whispers

The Tree only offers one Whisper Cache choice that will always be a Material Collection or a Collection of Chaos.

Corrupted Roots

Tree of Whispers

Whisper Caches sometimes contain Corrupted Roots.

Plant Corrupted Roots to grow an Exposed Root. These will attract nearby enemies, and have a chance to grow larger and summon more fearsome enemies.

The regions of Sanctuary each bear different fruit.

Wisdom of Whispers

Tree of Whispers

Gain 50% more Experience Orbs in Whisper Caches.

Fortune or Famine

Tree of Whispers

Whisper Caches from the Tree of Whispers are always at least of Greater Quality... or Junk.

Material Wealth

Tree of Whispers

The Tree now only offers Material Collections.

Grim Mysteries

Tree of Whispers

Collections of Chaos are replaced with Collections of Mysteries.

These caches can drop anything.

Chaotic Favor

Tree of Whispers

Completing a Whisper has a small chance to award a Collection of Chaos.

Branching Pathways

Nightmare Dungeons

When advancing to the next dungeon in a Nightmare Escalation, 2 additional Horadric Portals appear.

Fearless Conviction

Nightmare Dungeons

While in a Nightmare Dungeon, killing Elites and Champions grants you stacks of Conviction.

Getting hit by an Elite or Champion causes you to lose a stack of Conviction.

A Conviction Chest appears at the end of the dungeon that grants rewards for each remaining Conviction. This chest has a higher than normal chance to award Attuned Primordial Dust.

Goblinfall

Nightmare Dungeons

Treasure Goblins have a small chance to drop a Nightmare Sigil with the Treasure Breach affix.

Nemesis

Nightmare Dungeons

Activating a Shrine in a Nightmare Dungeon causes up to 7 Elites to ambush you.

Gauntlet

Nightmare Dungeons

While in a Nightmare Dungeon, slaying an enemy while empowered by a Shrine traps their soul within you.

When the Shrine buff expires, all trapped souls escape and spawn around you as renewed enemies.

Souls will be lost when moving between dungeons in an Escalation Dungeon.

Horadric Hunter

Nightmare Dungeons

Kill 25 Elites across Nightmare Dungeons to reveal a Horadric Altar. Activating it results in one of the following outcomes:

Summon Elites

Summon Treasure Goblins

Summon The Butcher

Gain Riches

Terrible Misfortune

Altar of Avarice

Nightmare Dungeons

Horadric Altars are replaced with Goblin Altars that only summon Treasure Goblins.

Cipher Maps

Nightmare Dungeons

Whenever you would reveal a Horadric Altar, you reveal 2 instead.

Rewarded Faith

Nightmare Dungeons

Gain a random additional buff when claiming a Shrine in a Nightmare Dungeon.

Greed is Good

Nightmare Dungeons

Killing a Treasure Goblin in a Nightmare Dungeon has a small chance to spawn a portal that takes you to the Goblin's Retreat.

Waking Spoils

Nightmare Dungeons

After completing a Nightmare Dungeon, a War's Bounty Chest will spawn that grants additional rewards.

Recurring Nightmare

Nightmare Dungeons

Bosses in Nightmare Dungeons gain +1 Monster Power and have a chance to drop an Escalation Sigil when slain.

Escalation Sigils can only appear in Torment+ difficulty.

Dread Revival

Nightmare Dungeons

Bosses in Nightmare Dungeons have a chance to revive when slain.

Night Terrors

Helltide

You have a chance to be ambushed by Hellborne in Nightmare Dungeons.

Hellborne have a small chance to drop a Profane Mindcage when slain.

Hell's Prize

Helltide

Hell's Prize chests will now appear in Helltide.

These chests offer a massive torrent of items for 666 Aberrant Cinders.

Fall of the Fell

Helltide

Harbingers will emerge from falling meteors twice as often, and drop twice as many Aberrant Cinders when slain.

Harbingers in Helltide have +1 Monster Power.

Meat Brothers

Helltide

Instead of Hellborne, two Butchers that are connected with flaming chains ambush you.

These Butchers each have a high chance to drop a Profane Mindcage when slain.

Hellmouth

Helltide

When a Hellwyrm emerges, it unleashes one of the following:

A Chaos Rift, which releases varied rewards upon collapse.

Maggots, which burst out Experience Orbs when slain.

Bloodseekers, which are more likely to drop Ancestral items when slain.

Wretched Vermin

Helltide

Demonic Rats will frequently attack you in Helltide.

Ashes to Ashes

Helltide

On death, lose all your Aberrant Cinders.

For every 100 Aberrant Cinders you pick up, you gain an additional 10.

Undying Embers

Helltide

You lose no Aberrant Cinders on death.

Infernal Rite

Helltide

Ambushes spawn up to four additional Hellborne.

Hellborne have a higher chance to drop Unique items when slain.

Planar Tremors

Helltide

Hellwyrms will always open a Chaos Rift, and enemies that emerge from it gain +1 Monster Power.

The first time a Chaos Rift opens, there is a chance that another will open.

Tainted Shrines

Helltide

While empowered by a Shrine in Helltide, slain enemies grant double the progress to your Threat Level.

Hated Foe

Helltide

Maximum Threat enemies that ambush you gain +1 Monster Power.

Chaotic Echoes

Helltide

Collapsed Chaos Rifts have a chance to reopen.

Bursting Brood

Helltide

Maggots and Pangs of Duriel explode when killed and will often drop Boss Trophies.

Writhe and Rot

Helltide

Hellwyrms will always spew Maggots that gain +1 Monster Power.

Sometimes, a Pang of Duriel will also crawl forth. Lair Keys often burst out of Pangs of Duriel.

Bound by Blood

Helltide

Bloodseekers are connected with flaming chains.

When slain, Bloodseekers drop items that match the category of the last opened Tortured Gift.

Crimson Scent

Helltide

Hellwyrms will always call forth Bloodseekers that gain +1 Monster Power.

Greater Bloodseekers may also emerge, which have a high chance to drop Legendary items when slain.

Idols of War

The Undercity

Greater Tributes of Armament more frequently drop throughout Sanctuary and have an additional Bargain choices.

Trials and Tributes

The Undercity

For each Portal Prankster you slay within the Undercity, a Tribute Chest appears after killing the District Boss.

Tribute Chests are unlocked by offering a Tribute.

Gutter Filth

The Undercity

When you activate any Beacon within the Undercity, there is a small chance to summon a Portal Prankster.

Invasion Portals will sometimes summon Rats of varying amounts.

Endless Swarm

The Undercity

Invasion Portals now appear in the Undercity.

The enemies that emerge grant Attunement when slain.

Jade Epiphany

The Undercity

When you gain an Attunement level in the Undercity, Experience Orbs appear around you.

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.

Finely Tuned

The Undercity

Gain additional Tuning Prisms when completing the Undercity at maximum Attunement.

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.

Pathfinder

The Undercity

When you reach maximum Attunement, a portal to the final floor of the Undercity appears.

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.

Unfortunate Souls

The Undercity

Invasion Portals can now summon Wisps that attach to you and vanish if you die.

Each Wisp you save will reward you with Forgotten Souls and other Crafting Materials at the end of the run.

Initiative

The Undercity

When you find the District Boss you gain the Initiative buff, which has a duration equal to your remaining Time. Initiative is lost upon death.

If you slay the District Boss with Initiative active, you receive Tribute rewards as if your Attunement was 2 higher (max 6).

All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.

Last Gasp

The Undercity

Time collected from slain enemies with 5 seconds or less remaining in the Undercity doubles the Time earned.

Bauble Day

The Undercity

If you slay a Portal Prankster within the Undercity, the Cabochon Merchant will appear after killing the District Boss.

The Cabochon Merchant will sell you Runes and Gems for Gold.

Lair of Plenty

Lair Bosses

Lair Bosses have +1 Monster Power.

Gain +1 Hoard Chest when you slay a Lair Boss (excluding Belial).

Infernal Deception

Lair Bosses

Belial can now ambush you after completing the Infernal Hordes.

Two by Two

Lair Bosses

After opening a Hoard Chest, there is a low chance a Portal will open that will take you to the Nemesis Lair, where you will fight two Initiate Lair Bosses at the same time.

Slaying both will yield great rewards.

You cannot enter a Nemesis Lair from Belial's throne room.

Nemesis Tides

Lair Bosses

Initiate Lair Bosses have a chance to appear instead of Helltide Commanders after Helltide Events.

Killing Lair Bosses in Helltides while earning the Event Mastery grants many random Lair Boss materials.

This only occurs in Torment+ difficulties.

Exotic Armory

Lair Bosses

Hoard Chests drop one additional Unique Item, but it can be for any Class.

Greater Nemesis

Lair Bosses

After completing a Nemesis Lair, there is a chance that a portal will appear that will take you to a Greater Nemesis Lair. Within this heinous place lies two Greater Lair Bosses.

Slaying both bosses will yield great rewards.

Lair of Runes

Lair Bosses

Lair Bosses have +1 Monster Power.

Lair Bosses have a higher chances of dropping specific Runes.

Ultimate Nemesis

Lair Bosses

After defeating all Bosses within the Greater Nemesis Lair, the Call Of Evil will appear. This altar will accept 3 Superior Lair Keys and open a Portal that takes you to the Ultimate Nemesis Lair.

Inside the Ultimate Nemesis Lair, all enemies gain +5 Monster Power. Defeating the Boss Encounter will award you with 10 Hoard Chests worth of Items.

Golden Hoard

Lair Bosses

All equipment that would drop from Hoard Chests are converted to Gold, except for Unique and Mythic items.

Lair Bosses

After opening a Tortured Gift in Helltides, there is a chance Grigoire's knights will ambush you.

When killed in Helltide, they may drop Unique Items available from his Hoard Chest.

Lair Bosses

When summoning the Blood Maiden in Helltides, there is a chance Duriel can be summoned instead.

Killing Duriel in Helltides can now drop Unique Items from his Hoard Chest.

Lair Bosses

When this occurs, killing the Nightmare Dungeon Boss has a chance to drop Unique Items from the Beast in Ice's Hoard Chest.

Children of Zir

Lair Bosses

When exploring the Pit, Lord Zir's Bloodseekers can now ambush you.

Killing them in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from his Hoard Chest.

Dog of Astaroth

Lair Bosses

When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the Amalgam of Rage has a chance to appear and attack you.

Killing the Amalgam of Rage in Nightmare Dungeons can drop Unique Items associated with Astaroth

Embers of Anguish

Lair Bosses

When exploring the Pit, Embers of Anguish can appear. Activating one drops Progress Orbs, and causes Andariel to ambush you at the end of the Pit.

Killing Andariel in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from her Hoard Chest.

Blood of Bartuc

Lair Bosses

After defeating the Fell Council, the Spoils of Greater Equipment may drop Unique Items associated with Bartuc.

Lair Bosses

Varshan and his minions can now appear in a Chaos Wave within the Infernal Hordes.

Bartuc and the Fell Council have +1 Monster Power and drop additional items when slain.

Infernal Hordes

Infernal Hoard

Infernal Hordes

Defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc reveals the Hoard of Greater Equipment, which contains a colossal deluge of equipment and other rewards.

Forged in Flame

Infernal Hordes

Flawless Find

Infernal Hordes

Infernal Hordes

Your Infernal Offerings are more likely to share a category with your previous choice.

Infernal Hordes

Infernal Hordes

Infernal Hordes

Infernal Hordes

Infernal Hordes

Infernal Hordes

Infernal Hordes

Infernal Hordes

Devil's Deal

Infernal Hordes

Choron's Haste

The Pit

The Pit gains the Haste Mastery objective.

When you kill the Guardian gain +1 Glyph Upgrade Chance for every 5 minutes left on the Timer.

Damned Thieves

The Pit

Orb Thieves have a chance to spawn in The Pit.

Orb Thieves drop an immense amount of Progress Orbs when killed, but leave a trail of Traps in their wake.

Heart of Stone

The Pit

Begin The Pit carrying the Heart of Stone, a fragile relic that is dropped after taking sustained damage and breaks after dropping 10 times.

While you carry it, enemies can drop bonus Progress Orbs.

After slaying the Guardian, Choron's Pedestal appears. Deposit the Heart of Stone within to gain +1 Glyph Upgrade Chance.

Choron's Blessing

The Pit

Gain +1 Glyph Upgrade Chance for completing The Pit.

Choron's Favor

The Pit

Special events and encounters become more common in higher Difficulty Tiers of The Pit.

Choron's Soul

The Pit

Choron's Soul now spawns with the Awakened Glyphstone.

Choron's Soul will drop 1 Progress Orb per Glyph Upgrade Chance offered.

All Progress Orbs in The Pit now grant Experience.

Choron's Flesh

The Pit

Choron's Flesh now spawns with the Awakened Glyphstone.

Choron's Flesh will allow you to get valuable Equipment by consuming one of your Glyph Upgrade Chances.

Choron's Shortcut

The Pit

Choron's Portal randomly appears in The Pit.

When used, it will send you to the entrance to the next Pit Floor, or become Unstable and summon either an Elite or a Shrine.

Cursed Rituals

The Pit

Different Ritual Sites now spawn in the Pit, and special Materials can spawn in different environments:

Choron's Blood appears in foliage dense regions

Choron's Sweat appears in stony locations

Choron's Tears appears in mystical places

Sacrificing these Materials at Ritual Sites may grant Gold, Materials, Items, and more.

Pit Butcher

The Pit

The Butcher has a chance to appear anywhere in The Pit.

The Butcher is a Guardian and killing him will complete the run.

However, you fail the run if he kills any player.

Cursed Merchant

The Pit

The Cursed Merchant has a chance to appear when completing the Pit.

The Cursed Merchant will sell Equipment for Artificers Stones.

Cursed Offerings

The Pit

Cursed Machines have a chance to appear while exploring the Pit.

Cursed Machines cost Artificers Stones to activate. Activating one will grant you valuable materials and attract vicious enemies.

The more Cursed Machines you find in a single Pit run, the more lucrative the rewards will become.

Choron's Wager

The Pit

Choron's Wager can appear in The Pit.
